secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: PostgreSQL connection string for the app database. In dev a local Postgres compose service provides a default; for a published app point this at your own Postgres/Supabase instance.

secrets.name: DISCORD_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Discord OAuth2 client ID (from the Discord Developer Portal → your application → OAuth2). Required for Discord login.

secrets.name: DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Discord OAuth2 client secret (from the Discord Developer Portal → your application → OAuth2). Required for Discord login.

secrets.name: ESPN_LEAGUE_ID
secrets.description: ESPN Fantasy league ID. Only needed for /admin/sync and the ESPN sync schedulers; the rest of the app runs without it.

secrets.name: ESPN_S2
secrets.description: ESPN private league auth cookie value (S2). Only needed for ESPN sync; the rest of the app runs without it.

secrets.name: ESPN_SWID
secrets.description: ESPN private league auth cookie value (SWID). Only needed for ESPN sync; the rest of the app runs without it.
